title: Credo to Showcase AI Memory and Storage Connectivity Solutions at FMS 2026
summary: Credo Technology Group Holding Ltd (Credo) (NASDAQ: CRDO), an innovator in providing connectivity at scale through fast, reliable, and energy-efficient system solutions, will showcase its latest interconnect products for AI memory and storage applications this week at the FMS (Future of Memory and Storage) 2026 conference. The FMS 2026 conference will take place August 4-6 at the Santa Clara Convention Center.
